Name: More Building Options - Pack 2
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34981/34981-1750989985-749709083.png[/img][/center]
Adds the following new building to Robin's building menu:

Empty Fishing Shack

A [i]completely useless[/i] building with a pointless pool of water in the middle. Max: 1.
Materials: 250 Wood, 150 Fiber, 100 Stone.
Cost: 17,500g.
Unlock: From start.
[i]Can only be built on the Farm.[/i]

Adds the following new building to the Wizard's building menu:

Magical Fishing Shack

An enchanting upgrade for the above, which lets you re-encounter any fish you've caught previously. Max: 1.
Materials: 100 Magic Bait, 10 Fairy Dust, 1 Prismatic Shard.
Cost: 250,000g.
Unlock: 8 Hearts w/Wizard and Willy.

How does it work?

After upgrading, there will be a magic book in the back of the shack that allows you to recall an area when focussed upon. The room will transform into a facsimile of the area, and appropriate fish which you've previously caught will populate the water. You can even place crab pots, though these will be left behind in the [i]memory [/i]of a given area when you leave. The external season/weather/time are irrelevant to whether you can catch a given fish or not, the only prerequisite is that you (or one of your Farmhands) has caught the fish before. You have the following [i]memories [/i]to choose from:

[list]
[*]Forest Basin: Forest River and Pond
[*]Mountain Brook: Mountain Lake
[*]Sandy Shore: Ocean and Night Market Submarine
[*]Tropical Lagoon: Ginger Island
[*]Overflow Tunnel: Sewers and Mutant Bug Lair
[*]Woodland Creek: Secret Woods
[*]Marshy Bog: Swamp
[*]Mirage Oasis: Desert
[*]Flooded Cavern: Mines
[*]The Loch: Legendary Fish
[/list]
For the vanilla fish, this is pretty straightforward. For mod-added fish, I've added compatibility for every mod I use and am happy to add more on request. I have had to use some artistic license with regards to what goes where (with the exception of Legendary Fish-- if it's legendary, it's in The Loch).

Downloads.Description: The second of three packs adding new constructible buildings to the game. This pack contains two new buildings: the Empty Fishing Shack and the Magical Fishing Shack. This gives you the ability to recatch any fish you've caught before, at any time!
